tei:div.tei:p: srid pa'i 'dre lnga'i glud bsngos bzhugs// hrīḥ bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo ni// che mchog pad+ma badz+ra rtsal// dmar gsal drang srong khros pa'i nyams// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa// lha lcam yum dang gnyis med 'khril// bde chen ngang du 'od du zhu// de las skad cig dran rdzogs su// bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sku// mdog dmar dus mtha'i me dpung bzhin// 'jigs rung gar gyi nyams dgu ldan// g.yas pas gser gyi rdo rje gdengs// khro chung tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// g.yon pas lcags kyi phur pa 'debs// lcags sdig nag po grangs med 'gyed// sku la dar nag ber chen gsol// zhabs la swag ti'i rgya l+h+wam mnabs// ral pa khams nag sprin ltar gtib// las bzhi 206)lhun grub rta skad 'tsher// dus gsum bde gshegs las la bskul// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dam chos ma lus 'dus pa'i gsung*// rig 'dzin ma lus thugs las shar// ye nas rang dang gnyis su med// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med gsal/ oṃ swa bha wa= stong pa'i ngang las rten 'byung 'gag pa med pa'i rol mo cir yang 'char ba las rin po che'i pho brang mdzes shing du yid du 'ong bar pho tang mo tang rgyang bu nam mkha' mda' 'phang chang bu la sogs pa'i dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa las byung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyi dbang po drug gi yul du gang la mkho ba'i 'dod pa'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por gyur/ sngags drug phyag drug gis brlabs te/ hrīḥ ngang nyid dbyings las rang snang 207)ba'i// nga ni pad+ma badz+ra rtsal// thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre dang*/ khyad par srid pa'i 'dre lnga la// phog pas sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon// rnam dag byang chub sems nyid las// ma rig 'khrul pa'i bag chags las// gzung 'dzin rtog par zhen pa yi// zhe sdang rang gar bzung ba'i rtsal// btsun pa rang rgyud rgyal po ste// g.yul 'khrugs srog la rngams pa'i 'dre/

srid pa'i= 'dod pa rang rgyud brten pa las// btsun ma gson bdud 'dre mo srid// bud med bsen mo'i gzugs su shar// kha smras gleng mo byed pa'i 'dre// srid pa'i= nga rgyal rmongs pa rang ga bar// zhen pa'i byis pa ngar 'dzin pas// srid pa the'u rang ja la 208) ma// srid pa'i= phrag dog 'dzin pas bcings ba'i bdag /sngags pa sems ngan dam dri yi// dngos grub bar gcod byed pa'i 'dre// srid pa'i= dug lnga rang stobs bsdo ba las// sde dpon ma rung yul 'dre srid// gnas gzhi yul khams phung ba'i 'dre// srid pa'i= khyed rnams 'khor du gtong pa'i bdag srid pa'i 'dre dgu gnod bcu dang*// dam sri yul 'dre thams cad kun// srid pa'i mdos la da tshur shog srid pa mdos kyi ra ba 'dir// sngon tshe dpal chen he ru kas/ khyod kyi gnas su bkas bcad pas// 'di na longs spyod phun sum tshogs// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs pa'i// bza' ba'i zas dang btung ba'i skom// gnas grogs mgon dang bran 'bangs bcas// yid la 'dod dgu 'dzom pa yi// mdos kyi gzhal yas khang du 209)bzhugs// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' la nyon/ sam bha ra dag mtshan bzhis bsngos la/ /kyai// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la/ khyod la 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams// rang rang yid la gang 'dod pa'i// zag med gter du brlabs te sbyin// pho brang ba gam g.yu las byas// rin chen sna tshogs rtsig pa la// bye ru dmar po'i kha bad mdzes// gser gyi rgya phig rgyal mtshan brgyan// gru bzhi kun nas 'khor ba las// dung gi sgo mo g.yu yis mdzes// nyi ma zla ba'i skar khung gsal// nang du longs spyod dpag tu med// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// gnas mal 'dug pa'i rten du bsngo// yon bzhes sbyin bdag bar chad sol// stag pa'i pho tang mtshal bas bkrag stag shar mda' gral gshib pa brgyad// thabs mchog 210)skyes pa pho yi glud// phrag pa g.yas su mda' yi mtshon// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// glang ma'i mo tang g.yu bas gsal// bud med 'phang gral tshogs pa brgya// shes rab za ma mo yi glud// phrag pa g.yon du 'phang gis brgyan// srid pa'i=

lus kyi rten du khyod la sbyin// mtho ba sgang du 'grim pa'i tshe// snyan pa'i glu len kyu ru ru// dma' ba sa na 'gro ba'i tshe// mdzes pa'i ldem bag chags shing 'gro// lha 'dre pho yi char gtogs la// dgyes sde glang ma'i mo tang bzang*// lha 'dre mo yi char gtogs la/ khyo pho stag pa'i pho ta rung*// lho smyug ldem pa'i ljon shing la// bal tshon kha dog mdzes pas brgyan// sgo gsum mtshon pa'i tshigs gsum pa// rgyang bu ngag gi 211)rten du sbyin// yon bzhes sbyin bdag bar chad sol// kun gzhi sems kyi nam mkha' la// nyon mongs lnga yi snal mas 'brel// tshogs brgyad rtog pa'i bya spus brgyan// gru bzhi kun nas lham me ba// lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can la// 'byung ba sems kyi rten du sbyin// yon bzhes sbyin bdag bar chad sol// thabs kyi smyug ma ldem pa la// shes rab sgro dang dar gyis spras// thabs shes 'brel ba'i mda' bkra 'di// skyes pa pho yi glud la sbyin// thabs kyi gsom shing drang po la// shes rab snal ma thag chas sbrel// thabs shes 'brel ba'i 'phang bkra 'di// za ma mo yi glud la sbyin// ston pas byin gyis rlabs pa'i zas// chang bu 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// dbang po drug gi 212)spyod yul du// longs spyod zad pa med par bsngo// sha dum zan chad gos dum dang*// dong tse mig mang rtags brgyad ris// rgyal srid sna bdun yul 'khor dang*// sa gzhi rgya mtsho ri rab dang*// nyi zla gza' skar 'ja' mtshon ris// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang cang shes rta// ma rmos lo tog dpag bsam shing*// gter chen bum pa bdud rtsi'i mdzod// ma tshang med pa'i yas rdzas rnams// bsngo ba nga yis ma nor gyi// len pa khyod kyi ma nor cig skyes pa pho yi glud du bsngo// srid pa'i byol zor bzlog tu gsol// za ma mo yi glud du bsngo// chags che nyam nga bsgyur du gsol// mo ngan rmi lam ngan pa bsgyur// than dang ltan ngan bsgyur du gsol// dmag sa 'khrugs sa rtsod pa bsgyur// ngan smras gleng mo

213)bsgyur du gsol// zhi zhing byams pa'i sems kyis su// srid pa'i mdos la dga' bas longs// phan pa'i sems kyis gnas su song*// phyin chad gnod pa ma ston cig 'dra glud bsngo ba ni/ kyai// mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan che// phung po khams dang skye mched tshang*// zer mo'i skra bzang dar bas ljang*// lung thang mig 'bras shin tu gsal// srab legs dar dmar lce bde zhing*// bse ru'i sha la mtshal gyi khrag /dung rus spu shel rtsa rgyus la// brgya byin lag pa'i skye mched mdzes// mi bas glud bzang skye mched tshang*// sngags kyi nus pas shes shing gsal// smra mkhas 'gros ldem dar zab brgyan// bla bas bza' che dkor cha 'dzom// nad pa bslu ba'i yon du bsngo// lus kyi glud du ngar mi dang*// tshe yi 214)glud du ting lo dang*// bla yi glud du mar me rnams// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin dag pas bsngo// ngar mi glud phran rgyal 'bangs 'dzom// srid pa'i 'dre lnga 'khor bcas la// bsngo zhing sbyin pas tshim gyur cig /bde mchog 'khor lo'i bka' ma bcag /dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dam ma bkral// rnal 'byor bdag gi tshig ma bslu// rang rang so so'i gnas su song*// sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor bcas la// ma blta ma rngams ma sems par// ri rab gling bzhi'i byang ngos na// sgra mi snyan pa longs spyod che// nor la bdag pos bzung ma myong*// zas la phongs pa'i bsam pa med// de ru 'dre lnga da gshegs shig /srid pa 'phrul gyi mdos chen 'di// bkrag gsal gsal stong sgyu ma yin// gang du chag kyang phrag ma 215)dog /gang du grum kyang ru ma nga*// gsal stong nam mkha'i ngang nyid du// chos rnams thams cad de ltar blta// chos sbyin byas nas lo bdud steng du bsgyur ro/ ༈ bca' thab dang la/ pho brang*// shing ris/ nam rgyang chang bu/ ting lo// sha dum// zan dum// gos// 'bru sna sogs gang 'byor// sbyin bdag gi 'dra glud dang ngar phran ci mang*// dbus su ban dhe rgyal po btsun gzugs// g.yas su bud med nag mo bya rog mgo

mdun du byis pa// g.yon du pho mtshan dmar po gyen 'greng*// rgyab tu khyi dmar po rnams bsag go / 216) ༄༅/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bdud kyi rgyal po bdud kyi rje// rkos rje drang dkar 'dir gshegs shig /btsan rgod ri bkra 'dir gshegs shig /phyi nang mchod pa'i dam tshig rdzas// mthun pa'i g.yag nag zhol po dang*// bya nag lug nag spyi dkar dang*/ khyi nag bya nag tshogs kyis bskang*// 'bru sna phye mar bsang dud dang*// gser skyems sman dang sha sna dang*// dar tshon stag gzig dkor chas mchod// gnas mgron gnyis kyi chad tho la// ma g.yel 'byung po'i rgyu 'phrang srungs// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di rdo rje 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i gsung ngo*// 218)
